name: Victor Negrescu - Après le considérant D - Am 5
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 1/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 entering the surplus of the financial year 2024
part_text: D a. whereas, given the EU’s level of indebtedness, the dramatic rise in interest costs, the absence of a repayment plan and the already heavy tax burden on European taxpayers, the only reasonable option is to allocate the entire budget surplus to the repayment of the NGEU loan;
